text:
maya: Quick ask — I'm pulling a sample of 6 recent onboarding calls to capture short 'vignettes' (1-2 line quotes) about friction points. Goal: give product actual voice-level examples to help prioritize. Need 2 people to listen + tag by EOD Fri. Tags: signup, integrations, latency, errors, config, docs, ease_of_install. Anyone?

tom: +1. How should we deliver tags? CSV in Drive or just a doc? Where do we paste quotes?

maya: Put into this template in Drive and add call_id + timestamp. header: ```call_id,timestamp,customer,tag,quote,severity``` Redact PII. Drive: https://drive.redwood/notes/vignettes-sample

leo: I can take 2 calls tomorrow. Will tag severity too. Do we want verbatim quotes or paraphrase?

maya: Verbatim if short, otherwise paraphrase. Keep to 1-2 lines. Mark paraphrase with (p).

olivia: fyi cs-bot exported the last 30 onboard transcripts and made clips — should save time. Link in thread. :rocket:

cs-bot: export complete — 6 transcripts copied to /drive/vignettes/1780012345. Auto-summaries attached (use as starter, still need human tagging).

tom: Cool. Once tags are in, product can run a quick frequency x severity matrix. My quick rule: prioritize items with count >=2 and avg severity >=4.

maya: Agreed. After tagging, please also add a short note (1-2 lines) suggesting possible fix area (docs, UX tweak, infra/latency). Product will compile top 3 quick wins + 1 medium term.

jordan: I can take the analysis step once tags are done. Also request adding tag `ease_of_install` — seen a few times in threads.

maya: Added `ease_of_install`. Timeline: tagging by Fri 6pm PT, analysis by Mon EOD, quick sync Wed 10am PT for 15m.

leo: Starting with call 4512 & 4517. Found a clear quote: "setup took two people and 4 hours, missing example config." tagging as ease_of_install (severity 4).

olivia: Tagged 2 calls and uploaded the doc here: https://drive.redwood/notes/vignettes-sample/olivia-upload. Included timestamps and verbatim quotes, redacted emails.

maya: Perfect — thanks. Jordan, you'll have both tags in the sheet. Tom, can you confirm product will use frequency*severity to rank and also include a quick cost estimate for infra fixes?

tom: Yep — frequency * severity for initial rank, then small-pass cost estimate for infra/infra-adjacent items. We'll flag any high-effort ones separately.

maya: Great. If anyone is blocked by access to the Drive or transcript clips ping me or @eng-oncall.

leo: No access initially but cs-bot fixed permission after I pinged. Starting listening now.

olivia: One more short vignette I added: "docs example is out-of-date, led to incorrect env var names" — tag = docs, severity 3.

maya: Love it. We'll assemble top 3 suggested fixes with sample quotes and expected impact. Thanks all — will post the final short deck in #product by Mon. Reminder: keep each quote to max 2 lines and redact PII.

tom: Thanks — appreciate the concrete user language. :thumbsup:

maya: Quick sync Wednesday 10am PT, 15m. Agenda: review top 3, agree owners.

cs-bot: Reminder set for Wed 10:00 PT. Meeting created: "Vignettes sync" — invites sent to participants.
